review.en: Ravi Shankar's first long-playing album, with Chatur Lal on tabla, gives three ragas the length the format newly allowed, the last filling a whole side. For many listeners in Europe and America it was a first full encounter with Hindustani classical music, a decade before the sitar entered rock. It remains a clear introduction to how a raga unfolds, from slow exposition to fast rhythmic play.
review.zh: 拉维·香卡的第一张密纹唱片，查图尔·拉尔担任塔布拉鼓。黑胶长度第一次允许拉格完整展开，最后一首占满整整一面。对欧美许多听众来说，这是第一次完整接触印度斯坦古典音乐，比西塔琴进入摇滚乐早了十年。如今它仍是了解拉格如何从缓慢铺陈走到快速节奏对答的清楚入门。
